message.content:
The patch-id needs to match `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?::[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)+$`. Let me fix the patch-id format and also review the motion syntax more carefully.

The motions use words: `str`, `var`, `call`, `let`, `if`, `match`, `ok`, `err`. Refs form a tree. Let me re-read the ISA:

- `match[value,b#,none,some]` — option_match
- `call[symbol,arg-ref...]`
- `var[s#|b#]`
- `ok[value]`
- `err[error]`
- `str[value]`

The root ref `r0` is the root of the replacement subtree. Each motion is `[word, r#, args...]`. The `s0` refers to `rawId` (first param = `param:...-raw-id`).
